add_library(curl INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(curl INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
target_link_libraries(curl INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/${CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI}/libcurl.a")
set(CURL_INCLUDE_DIRS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
set(CURL_LIBRARIES "-L${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/${CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI} -lcurl")
add_library(CURL::curl ALIAS curl)
